Layer.Text: Testing build.::Please keep in mind that the credits earned here will not::transfer to the main game.

Layer.LoadCreditAmmountCommand:
%function(self)
if Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST then self:settext( string.format('% 8d',Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST) ) self:sleep(1) if UpdateCoinAmmount then if CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) > 0 then self:bouncebegin(0.1) self:y(-35) self:sleep(1/6000) self:queuecommand('UpdateCoinAmmount') end end else self:settext( 'Not Found!' ) Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST = 0 end
end
Layer.UpdateCoinAmmountCommand:
%function(self)
if Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST then if GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_1) and not GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_2) then self:settext( string.format('% 8d',(Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST) + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) ) ) Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST = Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) Profile().CreditsEarnedTotalTEST = Profile().CreditsEarnedTotalTEST + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) Profile().TotalSongsPlayed = Profile().TotalSongsPlayed + 1
-- Add survival Time if SurvivedTime then Profile().TotalSongPlayTime = Profile().TotalSongPlayTime + SurvivedTime end
end
if GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_2) and not GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_1) then self:settext( string.format('% 8d',(Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST) + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_2) ) ) Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST = Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_2) Profile().CreditsEarnedTotalTEST = Profile().CreditsEarnedTotalTEST + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_2) Profile().TotalSongsPlayed = Profile().TotalSongsPlayed + 1
-- Add survival Time if SurvivedTime then Profile().TotalSongPlayTime = Profile().TotalSongPlayTime + SurvivedTime end
end
if GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_2) and GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_1) then self:settext( string.format('% 8d',(Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST) + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_2) ) ) Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST = Profile().CreditsEarnedTEST + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_2) Profile().CreditsEarnedTotalTEST = Profile().CreditsEarnedTotalTEST + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_1) + CoinGenerator(PLAYER_2) Profile().TotalSongsPlayed = Profile().TotalSongsPlayed + 1
-- Add survival Time if SurvivedTime then Profile().TotalSongPlayTime = Profile().TotalSongPlayTime + SurvivedTime end
end
AudioPlay('AerialRing_Appear' ) self:diffuse(1,1,0,1) self:bounceend(0.1) self:diffuse(1,1,1,1) self:y(-25) SaveProfiles() end
end
